title: CodeGuard AI: Architecture-Agnostic Security & Code Quality Agent
description: An AI agent that scans any codebase (any language or stack) for security vulnerabilities, AI-generated slop, coding gaps and loose ends, and reports each issue with file, line, severity, explanation and a suggested fix.

env.GROQ_API_KEY: optional - enables the AI triage layer; all rule-based checks run without it
